newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all firmer, gasoline strongest.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all firmer, gasoline strongest.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Monday, led by a $10 per tonne jump in gasoline.
Gasoline leapt higher after two days of strong gains in New York and widespread buying interest in Europe.
Naphtha prices lagged the gains in crude, but the market remained tight.
Gas oil gained around $7 per tonne, supported by gains in IPE futures and continuing shortages of low sulphur diesel.
Heavy fuel prices climbed about $1.00 a tonne in thin trading, dominated by Rotterdam barges which rose soon after the opening.
